name: realbag_empirical_v4
notes: realbag_empirical_v4, transcribed from Table 3 of the MatSense paper. Differs from v3 in that sidewalk is a MEASURED class (beta 0.3 -> 0.6529, alpha_rain 0.96 -> 0.9303) rather than carried over, plus a fourth-decimal revision of vegetation (0.8329 -> 0.8335, 0.972 -> 0.9713). asphalt, building and car are unchanged from v3. DECLARED, NOT MEASURED: the unknown fallback, and every snow ratio -- snow does not appear in Table 3 and is carried over unchanged from v3, which already flagged it as not measured. Do not report snow results under this profile as empirical. I_MCI = kappa*rho after Laasch et al. 2025, not a reflectance; g(R) shared across bags; band 20-60 m.
